full.name: class
full.description: Classes are converted to Calor class definitions

full.name: struct
full.description: Structs are converted to Calor struct definitions

full.name: enum
full.description: Enums are converted to Calor enum definitions

full.name: method
full.description: Methods are converted to Calor function definitions

full.name: property
full.description: Properties are converted to Calor property definitions

full.name: indexer
full.description: Indexers (this[]) are converted to Calor indexer definitions

full.name: field
full.description: Fields are converted to Calor field definitions

full.name: constructor
full.description: Constructors are converted to Calor constructors

full.name: if
full.description: If statements are converted to Calor IF blocks

full.name: foreach
full.description: Foreach loops are converted to Calor FOREACH blocks

full.name: while
full.description: While loops are converted to Calor WHILE blocks

full.name: switch
full.description: Switch statements are converted to Calor MATCH blocks

full.name: try-catch
full.description: Try/catch/finally blocks are converted to Calor TRY blocks

full.name: async-await
full.description: Async/await is converted to Calor async functions

full.name: lambda
full.description: Lambda expressions are converted to Calor lambda syntax

full.name: generics
full.description: Generic types and methods are supported

full.name: pattern-matching-basic
full.description: Basic pattern matching (type, constant, var) is supported

full.name: string-interpolation-to-string
full.description: An interpolated string whose target receives the formatted string (string, object) converts to a native Calor string with ${...} holes

full.name: null-coalescing
full.description: Null coalescing operators are converted

full.name: null-conditional
full.description: Null conditional operators are converted

full.name: linq-method
full.description: LINQ method syntax is fully supported with chained call decomposition

full.name: array-initializer
full.description: Bare array initializers are converted to Calor array nodes

full.name: object-initializer
full.description: Object initializers of plain Name = value assignments are converted to Calor §NEW with property assignments; other shapes are preserved (initializer-interop)

full.name: list-initializer
full.description: List initializers are converted to Calor §LIST nodes

full.name: hashset-initializer
full.description: HashSet initializers are converted to Calor §SET nodes

full.name: anonymous-type
full.description: Anonymous types are converted to Calor §ANON blocks

full.name: foreach-index
full.description: Indexed foreach via §EACH with optional index variable

full.name: attributes
full.description: Attributes are preserved via [@Name] syntax with proper AST

full.name: relational-pattern
full.description: Relational patterns (is > x, is < x) are converted to comparison expressions

full.name: compound-pattern
full.description: Compound patterns (and/or) are converted to boolean expressions

full.name: generic-type-constraint
full.description: Generic type constraints are supported via §WHERE syntax

full.name: goto
full.description: Goto statements are converted to §GOTO{label} nodes

full.name: labeled-statement
full.description: Labeled statements are converted to §LABEL{name} nodes

full.name: unsafe
full.description: Unsafe code blocks are converted to §UNSAFE blocks

full.name: pointer
full.description: Pointer types (int*) are supported with §ADDR and §DEREF

full.name: stackalloc
full.description: Stackalloc expressions are converted to §SALLOC nodes

full.name: fixed
full.description: Fixed statements are converted to §FIXED blocks

full.name: volatile
full.description: Volatile modifier is passed through to generated C# fields

full.name: extension-method
full.description: Extension methods are converted with 'this' parameter modifier preserved

full.name: operator-overload
full.description: Operator overloads are fully supported via §OP tags and converted to op_ CIL-convention methods

full.name: implicit-conversion
full.description: Implicit conversions are fully supported via §OP tags and converted to op_Implicit methods

full.name: explicit-conversion
full.description: Explicit conversions are fully supported via §OP tags and converted to op_Explicit methods

full.name: yield-return
full.description: Yield return/break statements are converted to Calor yield syntax

full.name: is-type-pattern
full.description: Type test patterns (is Type) are fully supported via TypeOperationNode

full.name: equals-operator
full.description: Custom == and != operators are fully supported via §OP tags and converted to op_Equality/op_Inequality methods

full.name: primary-constructor
full.description: Primary constructors (class Foo(int x)) are converted to readonly fields

full.name: range-expression
full.description: Range expressions (0..5, ..5, 5..) are converted to §RANGE nodes

full.name: index-from-end
full.description: Index from end expressions (^1) are converted to §^ nodes

full.name: named-argument
full.description: Named arguments (param: value) are supported in both statement and expression contexts

full.name: declaration-pattern
full.description: Declaration patterns (is Type name) are fully supported via TypeOperationNode with variable binding

full.name: throw-expression
full.description: Throw expressions are converted to §ERR nodes

full.name: nameof
full.description: nameof() expressions are preserved as (nameof x) in Calor and emit nameof(x) in C#

full.name: nested-generic-type
full.description: Nested generic types like Dictionary<string, List<int>> are fully supported with inline angle bracket syntax

full.name: nested-type
full.description: Nested type declarations (classes, structs, interfaces, enums inside other types) are supported

full.name: in-parameter
full.description: in parameters and §A{in} arguments convert natively (a C# ref argument to an in parameter becomes §A{in}). A call statement that omits in, or whose by-reference operand contains a call, creation, assignment or ++/-- or indexes a non-array, stays C# (§RAW); in indexer parameters preserve the member

full.name: checked-block
full.description: checked/unchecked wrapper stripped, body statements fully preserved

full.name: with-expression
full.description: with expressions (record copying) are converted to §WITH blocks

full.name: init-accessor
full.description: init keyword is handled in property accessors

full.name: required-member
full.description: required modifier on properties and fields is detected and emitted

full.name: list-pattern
full.description: list/slice patterns ([a, b, ..rest])

full.name: lock-statement
full.description: Lock statements are converted to §SYNC blocks with full semantics

full.name: readonly-struct
full.description: Readonly structs are converted with struct and readonly modifiers

full.name: namespace-single-scope
full.description: One block-scoped or file-scoped namespace converts natively with qualified identities and namespace-local usings

full.name: utf8-string-literal
full.description: UTF-8 string literals (C# 11) are fully supported — u8 suffix is preserved through round-trip

full.name: char-literal
full.description: Char literals use native single-quoted Calor syntax and emit compile-time-constant C# char literals

full.name: type-pattern
full.description: Type-test and typed-declaration patterns (case Type: / case Type name:) are represented natively via TypePatternNode, preserving the runtime type test and binding

full.name: char-literal-surrogate
full.description: Lone-surrogate char literals round-trip as escaped UTF-16 code units in single-quoted Calor literals

full.name: binary pattern (and/or)
full.description: Pattern combinators (and/or) are converted to AndPatternNode/OrPatternNode

full.name: unary pattern (not)
full.description: Negated patterns (not) are converted to NegatedPatternNode

full.name: complex-recursive-pattern
full.description: Property patterns and positional patterns are fully supported including nested patterns

full.name: postfix-operator
full.description: Postfix i++/i-- is supported via hoisting strategy — original value is preserved in a temp variable

full.name: default-parameter
full.description: Default parameter values are converted to §I{type:name} = value syntax

full.name: parallel
full.description: Parallel.For/ForEach/Invoke are converted as method calls

full.name: plinq
full.description: PLINQ .AsParallel() chains are converted as method calls

full.name: com-interop
full.description: COM attributes ([ComImport], [Guid]) are preserved

full.name: extern-method
full.description: Extern methods with [DllImport] are fully supported

full.name: dllimport
full.description: [DllImport] attribute for P/Invoke is fully supported

full.name: tuple-type
full.description: Tuple types in signatures like (int, string) are mapped

full.name: tuple-literal
full.description: Tuple literals (a, b) are fully supported

full.name: span
full.description: Span<T> and ReadOnlySpan<T> types are supported

full.name: memory
full.description: Memory<T> and ReadOnlyMemory<T> types are supported

full.name: multidim-array
full.description: Rectangular arrays (int[,], int[,,]) convert natively: sized creation, nested initializers (§ROW), element access, and new[,] of a known type. new[,] of an unknown type, and an element that cannot be written in place (a collection initializer or a multi-line element, array-element-block), are preserved as C#

full.name: refinement-type
full.description: Refinement types (§RTYPE) define base types constrained by predicates; erased to base types in C#

full.name: proof-obligation
full.description: Proof obligations (§PROOF) declare conditions to be verified; emitted as comments or runtime checks

full.name: indexed-type
full.description: Indexed types (§ITYPE) define size-parameterized types for bounds checking; erased to base types in C#

full.name: index-bounds
full.description: Index bounds obligations verify array/list accesses are within bounds using Z3

full.name: notnull-constraint
full.description: notnull type constraint supported via TypeConstraintKind.NotNull

full.name: explicit-interface
full.description: Explicit interface implementations preserved as IInterface.MethodName

full.name: verbatim-identifier
full.description: C# @keyword identifiers mapped to backtick syntax in Calor

full.name: conditional-using
full.description: Using directives inside #if blocks supported via §PP wrapping §U

full.name: anonymous-method
full.description: C# delegate { } anonymous methods are converted to Calor lambda expressions

full.name: ref-expression
full.description: ref expressions never convert natively: members with ref locals, ref returns (block or expression bodied), conditional refs or ref assignments are preserved as C#, with a ref-parameter warning

full.name: global-qualified-name
full.description: global:: qualified names are converted to unqualified references

full.name: implicit-element-access
full.description: Implicit element access (['key'] in initializers) is converted to index access

full.name: var-pattern
full.description: var patterns (is var name, is var (a, b)) converted with variable hoisting

partial.name: interface
partial.description: Public abstract signature-only methods, properties, and indexers are native; interfaces with non-representable contract members are preserved whole as counted C# interop
partial.workaround: Keep default, static abstract/virtual, private, event, and nested-type interface contracts as exact C# interop

partial.name: for
partial.description: Proven constant int loops use native ranges. Other loops use scoped native while lowering that reevaluates conditions and preserves continue/finally/disposal order. Order-sensitive header expressions and operations are preserved inline; ref locals, pattern/out header variables and tuple headers use explicit loop interop.

partial.name: string-interpolation
partial.description: Interpolated strings assigned, returned or passed as string or object convert natively, keeping format specifiers, alignment, culture and hole order. FormattableString and IFormattable targets with at least one hole convert natively with an explicit cast that keeps the selected overload. [InterpolatedStringHandler] targets (custom and .NET handler overloads such as StringBuilder.Append) and hole-free FormattableString targets keep their statement as C# interop; holes outside the native subset keep their C# text
partial.workaround: Keep handler-based calls (logging, assertion and builder APIs) as C# interop, or pass a formatted string to a string overload

partial.name: string-interpolation-formattable
partial.description: An interpolated string with at least one hole targeting FormattableString or IFormattable converts natively with an explicit cast to that type, so the same overload is selected. Hole-free targets are preserved (string-interpolation-formattable-constant), and holes outside the native subset keep their C# text (string-interpolation-hole)
partial.workaround: Review preserved hole-free FormattableString calls; they stay C# interop

partial.name: string-interpolation-hole
partial.description: Holes made of names, string/char/bool/int literals, doubles with a fractional part, dotted member access, operators, nameof, typeof, and calls with a dotted target and positional arguments convert natively. Other holes (object creation, indexing, ?., ?:, lambdas, named or ref arguments, generic calls) keep their original C# text as §CS{...} inside the hole, with assumed effects
partial.workaround: Move the expression into a local before the interpolated string to convert it natively

partial.name: conditional-access-shape
partial.description: Conditional member and positional invocation chains convert natively. Conditional indexing, named/ref arguments, generic conditional calls and unsupported grouping preserve the original expression as counted C# interop
partial.workaround: Keep the counted interop, or express the null check and dependent operations as explicit statements

partial.name: conditional-expression-hoisting
partial.description: Conditional increments, calls and throw expressions remain in their native evaluation region. Assignment operands and conversions requiring unsafe eager preludes preserve the original expression as counted C# interop
partial.workaround: Keep the counted interop, or express conditional side effects as explicit statements before converting

partial.name: linq-query
partial.description: Single-from enumerable queries and simple terminal join-select queries use method chains; group retains both key and element selectors. Query providers/unresolved invocation sources, typed ranges, nonidentity continuations and transparent-identifier scopes (let, complex joins and additional from) are explicitly preserved as C# interop. Complex or unresolved selectors remain inline and deferred.

partial.name: initializer-interop
partial.description: Object and collection initializers with no faithful native form are preserved verbatim as inline C# interop and reported as a loss: nested member initializers (P = { ... }), indexer and multi-value element initializers, Add-collections other than List<T>/HashSet<T>, values or constructor arguments the emitter could hoist ahead of the constructor, and initializers outside a local, field or property initializer, return, expression or lambda body, foreach source, switch arm or plain assignment statement (a tuple, anonymous object or collection expression holding one is preserved whole). Event field initializers keep their member as C#.

partial.name: dictionary-initializer
partial.description: Literal Add-style Dictionary initializers in direct local bindings and returns use §DICT. Other contexts, index setters, constructor/comparer arguments, nonliteral entries, target-typed initializers and other concrete dictionary types are explicitly preserved as inline C# interop to retain their operations, type initialization order and evaluation timing.

partial.name: ref-parameter
partial.description: ref parameters and ref arguments convert natively (§A{ref}) and pass the caller's storage, never a copy. Ref locals and returns, conditional refs, scoped and ref readonly parameters, this-ref extensions, by-reference delegates, constructor and indexer arguments, and method-generic by-reference parameters are preserved as C#
partial.workaround: Keep the preserved member as C# interop; no tuple or wrapper form is equivalent

partial.name: out-parameter
partial.description: out parameters and out arguments convert natively (§A{out}, out _ discards). Flow attributes such as [NotNullWhen] are copied but inert. Method-generic out parameters are preserved as C#
partial.workaround: Keep the preserved member as C# interop; no tuple or Result<T, E> form is equivalent

partial.name: pattern-matching-advanced
partial.description: Advanced patterns (list, property, relational) may be simplified
partial.workaround: Review converted patterns for semantic correctness

partial.name: dynamic
partial.description: Dynamic type is converted to 'any' with warning
partial.workaround: Consider using generics or interfaces

partial.name: generic-method-expression
partial.description: Generic method calls like Option<T>.Some() in expressions may have issues
partial.workaround: Assign generic method results to intermediate variables before use

partial.name: target-typed-new
partial.description: Target-typed new with arguments is converted using 'object' placeholder type
partial.workaround: Review and replace 'object' with the correct type name

partial.name: null-conditional-method
partial.description: Null-conditional method calls (obj?.Method()) are converted with AST-based args
partial.workaround: Review converted null-conditional method calls for correctness

partial.name: out-var
partial.description: out var x / out T x in an expression statement, local declaration, return or if condition directly in a block lowers to a mutable binding before the statement when the type is expressible and the name collides with nothing in scope (it starts at default). Chained assignments, a visible symbol named default, loop, using and lock headers, lambdas, queries, interpolation holes, filters, initializers and expression-bodied members are preserved as C#
partial.workaround: Declare the variable before the statement and pass it with out

partial.name: collection-expression
partial.description: Array-targeted collection expressions convert natively; other targets preserve C# to retain their runtime collection type

partial.name: preprocessor-directive
partial.description: Default conversion preserves all #if/#elif/#else branches as explicit §PP AST across module declarations/usings, class and struct members, statements, nesting, and partial declarations
partial.workaround: Interface and enum member-level directives may use verbatim interop; review those counted preservation boundaries

partial.name: conditional-declaration
partial.description: Conditional declarations preserve every branch in source order, using explicit interop whenever a declaration is not natively representable
partial.workaround: Review InteropPreserved losses; preservation is lossless but not fully native

partial.name: namespace
partial.description: Single namespace scopes convert natively; lossless conversion preserves multiple, nested, or mixed global/namespace topologies as whole-file C# interop
partial.workaround: Use lossy mode for native §NS topology, or keep the lossless whole-file interop boundary

partial.name: namespace-topology
partial.description: Multiple, nested, or mixed global/namespace scopes convert natively only in explicit lossy mode; default lossless mode uses whole-file interop
partial.workaround: Review the recorded namespace-topology interop loss or explicitly choose lossy native §NS conversion

partial.name: local-function
partial.description: A non-capturing local function declared directly in a method body, without attributes, type parameters, async/unsafe/extern, yield, nested local functions, or ref/out/in/params/default parameters, converts in place to a nested §F (a C# static local function). A member with any other local function is preserved verbatim as a §CSHARP interop block
partial.workaround: Make the local function static (pass captured values as parameters) and non-generic, or keep the member as a §CSHARP interop block

partial.name: complex-is-pattern
partial.description: Simple is-pattern checks and declaration patterns convert natively; property and positional patterns preserve C# to retain evaluation and binding semantics

partial.name: collection-spread
partial.description: A single array spread into an array converts natively; other spreads preserve C# and its enumeration order

partial.name: collection-spread-mixed
partial.description: Mixed collection spreads preserve C# to retain enumeration and element evaluation order

partial.name: implicit-new-with-args
partial.description: Target-typed new expressions are supported but type inference uses 'object' placeholder when target type cannot be determined

partial.name: tuple-deconstruction
partial.description: Flat identifier tuple assignments and certified scalar declarations stay atomic; other declarations, complex operands and expression-valued assignments use counted C# interop to preserve evaluation order and Deconstruct semantics

partial.name: pragma
partial.description: #pragma directives, including warning disable/restore and checksum, use an explicit source-ordered directive node
partial.workaround: Embedded placements that cannot be structurally owned preserve their enclosing C# boundary

notsupported.name: record
notsupported.description: Records are not natively supported; record declarations are preserved verbatim as §CSHARP interop blocks (counted as a conversion loss)
notsupported.workaround: Rewrite the record as an explicit class before migration, or keep it as a §CSHARP interop block

notsupported.name: string-interpolation-handler
notsupported.description: An interpolated string (or a + chain of them) passed to an [InterpolatedStringHandler] parameter cannot be represented in Calor; the enclosing statement or member is preserved as C# interop, or the conversion fails when preservation is off
notsupported.workaround: Keep the call as C# interop, or call a string overload with an already formatted string

notsupported.name: string-interpolation-formattable-constant
notsupported.description: An interpolated string with no holes targeting FormattableString or IFormattable (for example FormattableString.Invariant($"text")) has no Calor form; the enclosing statement or member is preserved as C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep the call as C# interop, or pass a plain string

notsupported.name: array-element-block
notsupported.description: An array element that Calor writes as a block (a collection initializer, or a multi-line element such as an anonymous object in a rectangular array row) preserves its statement as counted C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Bind the element to a local first, then use the local in the array

notsupported.name: static-abstract-member
notsupported.description: static abstract/virtual interface members are not supported
notsupported.workaround: Use instance methods or regular static methods

notsupported.name: ref-struct
notsupported.description: ref struct types are preserved whole as counted C# interop so stack-only semantics remain exact
notsupported.workaround: Keep the type as exact C# interop or use a regular struct only when stack-only behavior is unnecessary

notsupported.name: await-foreach
notsupported.description: Members containing await foreach are preserved whole as counted C# interop so async enumeration and disposal semantics remain exact
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing member as exact C# interop

notsupported.name: await-using
notsupported.description: Members containing await using statements or declarations are preserved whole as counted C# interop so asynchronous disposal remains exact
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing member as exact C# interop

notsupported.name: scoped-parameter
notsupported.description: Members with scoped parameters are preserved whole as counted C# interop so ref-safety semantics are not stripped
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing member as exact C# interop until scoped ref-safety is modeled

notsupported.name: using-declaration
notsupported.description: Using declarations are preserved with their complete containing member because resource lifetime extends to the containing scope
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing member as exact C# interop or rewrite it as an explicit using statement with the same lifetime

notsupported.name: standalone-block
notsupported.description: Members containing bare statement blocks are preserved whole as counted C# interop so lexical scope and every child statement remain exact
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing member as exact C# interop until standalone lexical scopes have a native Calor node

notsupported.name: conditional-member
notsupported.description: Class and struct member branches are native §PP AST; interface and enum member branches may require verbatim interop
notsupported.workaround: Review interface and enum member-level conditional blocks

notsupported.name: conditional-statement
notsupported.description: Method block statement branches preserve #if/#elif/#else nesting as §PP AST; unsupported statement shapes remain explicit interop
notsupported.workaround: Review counted interop inside complex switch/accessor/lambda directive placements

notsupported.name: conditional-unmodeled-placement
notsupported.description: Conditional expressions, accessors, lambdas, switch sections, local functions, and similar unmodeled placements preserve the complete enclosing C# boundary as scoped interop
notsupported.workaround: The source is lossless but non-native; review the counted interop boundary

notsupported.name: conditional-top-level-statement
notsupported.description: A compilation unit containing conditional top-level statements is preserved verbatim as global C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep the compilation unit as C# interop until top-level conditional statements are modeled natively

notsupported.name: top-level-directive-ordering
notsupported.description: Compiler directives interleaved with top-level statements preserve the complete compilation unit verbatim
notsupported.workaround: Keep the compilation unit as C# interop until directives can be represented inside synthetic Main without changing scope

notsupported.name: compilation-unit-using-ordering
notsupported.description: A using directive after a declaration or completed conditional region preserves the complete compilation unit verbatim
notsupported.workaround: Keep the source as C# interop so configuration-specific using legality and diagnostics remain unchanged

notsupported.name: conditional-namespace
notsupported.description: Conditional namespace wrappers and their branch contents are preserved verbatim at compilation-unit scope
notsupported.workaround: Preserve namespace-wrapped branches as compilation-unit C# interop

notsupported.name: interface-method-semantics
notsupported.description: Abstract signature-only interface methods are native; default/private/static/body-bearing methods preserve the declaration as interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep non-signature interface methods as exact C# interop declarations

notsupported.name: interface-semantics
notsupported.description: Non-public, partial, or otherwise modified interface declarations preserve the complete interface as exact C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep the interface as C# interop until declaration modifiers are represented natively

notsupported.name: interface-property-semantics
notsupported.description: Body-bearing, private, static, virtual, or otherwise non-representable interface properties preserve the containing interface as exact C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing interface as exact C# interop

notsupported.name: interface-indexer-semantics
notsupported.description: Body-bearing, private, static, virtual, or otherwise non-representable interface indexers preserve the containing interface as exact C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing interface as exact C# interop

notsupported.name: interface-member
notsupported.description: Events, nested types, and other non-representable interface members preserve the containing interface as exact C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep the containing interface as exact C# interop

notsupported.name: delegate-semantics
notsupported.description: Public non-generic delegates without attributes or extra modifiers are native; all other delegate declarations preserve exact C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Keep attributed, generic, non-public, or modified delegates as exact C# interop

notsupported.name: csharp-script
notsupported.description: Script compilation units, including #r and #load, are preserved by exact whole-unit passthrough
notsupported.workaround: Use whole-unit C# script passthrough until native script lowering exists

notsupported.name: compilation-unit-attribute
notsupported.description: Assembly/module attributes preserve the complete compilation unit verbatim
notsupported.workaround: Preserve the compilation unit as C# interop

notsupported.name: extern-alias
notsupported.description: Compilation units with extern aliases preserve the complete source verbatim
notsupported.workaround: Preserve the compilation unit and aliased references as C# interop

notsupported.name: iterator-accessor
notsupported.description: A property or indexer whose accessor uses yield return/yield break is preserved verbatim as a §CSHARP interop block; Calor has no iterator accessors (Calor0209)
notsupported.workaround: Move the iterator body into a method (§MT with §YIELD) and have the accessor return its result, or keep the member as a §CSHARP interop block

notsupported.name: partial-property
notsupported.description: Each declaration of a partial property or indexer (C# 13) is preserved verbatim as a §CSHARP interop block; Calor has no partial members
notsupported.workaround: Merge the defining and implementing declarations into one ordinary property before migration, or keep both as §CSHARP interop blocks

notsupported.name: default-lambda-parameter
notsupported.description: default lambda parameters (C# 12) are not supported
notsupported.workaround: Use method overloads or null checks inside lambda

notsupported.name: file-scoped-type
notsupported.description: File-local classes, structs, interfaces, enums, and delegates are preserved whole as counted C# interop so file-only accessibility remains exact
notsupported.workaround: Keep the declaration as exact C# interop

notsupported.name: generic-attribute
notsupported.description: generic attributes (C# 11) are not supported
notsupported.workaround: Use typeof() parameter in non-generic attribute

notsupported.name: using-type-alias
notsupported.description: using type aliases for tuples/complex types (C# 12) are not supported
notsupported.workaround: Define explicit record or class types

notsupported.name: unsupported-binary-operator
notsupported.description: Binary operator has no Calor mapping; the containing member is preserved as §CSHARP interop (never substituted with +)
notsupported.workaround: Rewrite using a supported operator or keep the member as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: unsupported-compound-assignment
notsupported.description: Compound assignment operator (e.g. >>>=) has no Calor mapping; the containing member is preserved as §CSHARP interop (never emitted as a plain assignment)
notsupported.workaround: Rewrite as x = x OP y with a supported operator, or keep the member as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: embedded-assignment
notsupported.description: An assignment used as a value (a = b = G(), int z = y = G(), return x = G()) converts natively when it is the whole statement, a single local initializer or a returned value, that statement sits directly in a block, and every target is a variable, field or property of this or a type: the right-hand side runs once into a typed temp. Other positions (conditions, arguments, unbraced bodies, switch sections, lambdas and expression bodies, indexer or member targets) keep the statement as C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Assign to the variable in its own statement, then use the variable

notsupported.name: compound-assignment-order
notsupported.description: Assignments, compound assignments, ++ and -- convert natively with C#'s order: the target's receiver and arguments run first and once, then a compound read, then the right-hand side. A receiver or argument that would run twice or after hoisted statements is bound to a temp. Shapes that cannot keep that order stay C# interop: a struct receiver that would need a temp, a postfix ++/-- whose hoist would pass an earlier read of the same variable or an earlier call, and a do-while condition, catch filter or switch-expression guard that would need hoisted statements
notsupported.workaround: Evaluate the receiver, index or right-hand side into a local in its own statement first

notsupported.name: compound-assignment-narrowing
notsupported.description: A compound assignment or ++/-- whose result C# narrows implicitly converts with an explicit cast for built-in numeric and char targets. Other narrowed targets (a nullable small integer, for which Calor's cast would drop the ?) stay C# interop
notsupported.workaround: Write the assignment with an explicit cast, as in b = (byte)(b + 10)

notsupported.name: default-member-collision
notsupported.description: A default value (int x;, default, default(T)) where a symbol named default is in scope, or declared at any accessibility in a containing or base type, keeps its statement as C# interop, because Calor's default would read that member
notsupported.workaround: Rename the member named default, or initialize the variable with an explicit value

notsupported.name: unsupported-switch-label
notsupported.description: Switch label kind (e.g. pattern case label) is not convertible; the containing member is preserved as §CSHARP interop (never broadened to a wildcard)
notsupported.workaround: Rewrite as a constant case label or if/else chain, or keep the member as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: unsupported-pattern-operator
notsupported.description: Relational/binary pattern operator has no Calor mapping; the containing member is preserved as §CSHARP interop (never defaulted to ==/&&)
notsupported.workaround: Rewrite the pattern with supported operators, or keep the member as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: unsupported-prefix-operator
notsupported.description: Prefix unary operator (e.g. unary +) has no Calor node; the containing member is preserved as §CSHARP interop (never substituted with negation)
notsupported.workaround: Drop the redundant unary + or keep the member as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: unsupported-slice-subpattern
notsupported.description: A list-pattern slice carrying an inner sub-pattern (e.g. ..[1,2]) constrains the remaining elements; it is preserved as §CSHARP interop (never broadened by dropping the sub-pattern)
notsupported.workaround: Match the remaining elements explicitly, or keep the member as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: generic-delegate
notsupported.description: Generic delegate declarations are preserved verbatim as counted §CSHARP interop so type parameters and constraints remain exact
notsupported.workaround: Use Func<>/Action<> or keep the delegate as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: conversion-error
notsupported.description: The converter crashed on this construct; the containing statement/member is preserved as §CSHARP interop
notsupported.workaround: Simplify the construct or keep it as §CSHARP interop

notsupported.name: unknown-expression
notsupported.description: Unknown or unsupported expression syntax
notsupported.workaround: Review and manually convert the expression

notsupported.name: unknown-literal
notsupported.description: Unknown or unsupported literal type
notsupported.workaround: Use a supported literal type

notsupported.name: unknown-pattern
notsupported.description: Unrecognized pattern syntax
notsupported.workaround: Simplify pattern or use if-else with explicit conditions

notsupported.name: nullable-directive
notsupported.description: #nullable directives use an explicit source-ordered directive node when their boundary is modeled
notsupported.workaround: Unmodeled embedded placement preserves the enclosing C# boundary

notsupported.name: warning-directive
notsupported.description: #warning directives use an explicit source-ordered directive node and retain compiler warning behavior
notsupported.workaround: Unmodeled embedded placement preserves the enclosing C# boundary

notsupported.name: error-directive
notsupported.description: #error directives use an explicit source-ordered directive node; active errors remain honest compilation failures
notsupported.workaround: Resolve active compiler errors in the selected configuration

notsupported.name: line-directive
notsupported.description: #line directives are preserved verbatim in source order
notsupported.workaround: Preserve the complete compilation unit to retain exact line mapping
